name: Hylo Open
stakes: The Hylo Open delivered a significant double title triumph for India, injecting crucial momentum and confidence into PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen's seasons.
summary:
The Hylo Open in Saarbrücken proved to be a remarkable tournament for India, culminating in a rare double triumph on Sunday. PV Sindhu showcased her championship pedigree, clinching the Women's Singles title with a dominant performance in the final. This victory marks her second BWF title of the season, a crucial boost that significantly strengthens her bid for a spot in the prestigious year-end World Tour Finals.

Joining her in the winner's circle was Lakshya Sen, who ended his much-anticipated title drought by securing the Men's Singles crown. His strong showing throughout the tournament, capped by a stellar performance in the final, signals a welcome return to form for the young Indian star. While other Indian contenders like Satwik & Chirag, Treesa & Gayatri, HS Prannoy, and Malvika Bansod exited earlier in the competition, the spotlight firmly remains on Sindhu and Sen's impressive victories, which highlight India's growing prowess on the international badminton circuit.
